feedback: The candidate is a faithful, well-formed RM for this task. FORMAT: All required headers are present in order (STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION, REWARD_FUNCTION). FINAL_STATES: u3 is nonempty, u3 is declared in STATES, and it is the accepting state for the task, entered only via target_picked_up (the mission box ends the episode). Each REWARD_FUNCTION arc matches a TRANSITION_FUNCTION arc exactly; zero-reward else-loops are correctly implicit. SEMANTIC FIDELITY: The chain u0 -has_door_key-> u1 -door_open-> u2 -target_picked_up-> u3 mirrors the environment-guaranteed orderings (key before open, open before box) and the example tasks. The task's until-clause is scoped correctly: key_lost is penalized (-0.5) only in u1, i.e., after the key has been held but before the door has ever opened; in u2 a key drop while the door is closed (only possible after the door was opened once and toggled shut) falls to the else-loop without penalty, exactly matching 'until the door has been opened once' and the required post-opening drop to free the hands. REGRESSIONS: None are required here, and the RM correctly avoids regressing u2 when door_open turns false again, since the prohibition is permanently lifted after the first opening; u2 persists the 'opened once' fact, so box pickup is not required to coincide with an open door. PERSISTENT/EVENT DISTINCTIONS: key_lost (one-step event) is charged once per occurrence via the self-loop; door_open (persistent) is used as an edge into the persistent state u2. COVERAGE: Every state has a per-state else self-loop covering irrelevant labels (key_lost in u0/u2/u3, key re-acquisition in u1/u2, door_open re-firing in u2/u3, no-ops). REWARD SAFETY/DENSITY: Positive progress rewards 0.1 < 0.2 < 1.0 are dense, monotone, and non-farmable - u0, u1 milestones are earned at most once because no transition returns to u0 or re-enters u1 from u2, and total positive reward is bounded at 1.3. The -0.5 penalty is proportionate, cannot trap the agent (a key dropped pre-opening sits in the starting room and can be re-picked; the door is never relocked, so it can be reopened without the key), and does not create an incentive to avoid the task. REACHABILITY: All four states and every listed transition are reachable (pickup key, toggle door, drop/re-pick key, pickup box), with no dead ends. No defects found; review only, artifact unchanged.
